title: Document manual recovery of a corrupt mutation intent
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: when `mutation-intent.json` is malformed or unsafe, `recoverMutationIntentUnlocked` (src/core/store.ts:266-286) throws `mutation_intent_invalid` on every lock acquisition, bricking ALL writes until the file is manually removed. This fail-safe is correct but currently only discoverable from the error hint. Document the manual-repair procedure (validate flags the file; inspect the ledger backup; remove/replace the intent) in the docs referenced by the hint.
acceptance: The `mutation_intent_invalid` hint points at a documented manual-repair procedure.
The procedure is written up in docs/ (e.g. docs/error-philosophy.md or a dedicated page) with concrete steps and safety notes.
No code behavior changes are required unless the documentation exposes a gap.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #17 (operational). Fail-safe design is sound; this is a documentation task.
